collection_method: Clicked every included source row with autoplay disabled and verified off; waited 500 ms after each click; captured visible radio IDs and positions, seconds, frequency, call IDs and audio links. Unix timestamps determine America/Denver date. Source listing crossed both date boundaries. November 1 covers 25 hours due to daylight-saving transition.
